cards.name: Visa Infinite

fee_waiver.text: First year free; later years reversed with AED 100,000 prior-12-month spend

rules.name: Reduced categories
rules.conditions: supermarkets, groceries, government, utilities, fuel, car rental, auto dealers, insurance, fast food, education: 0.5 pt local, 0.75 abroad

golf.text: 4 free rounds a month at The Track Meydan and Arabian Ranches
golf.conditions: AED 10,000 retail spend in the calendar month

cinema.text: 50% off up to 6 VOX tickets a month

lounge.text: Visa Airport Companion: up to 12 visits/yr (first 2 free, more after a USD 1 international purchase); else USD 32

welcome_offer.text: AED 750 cashback after AED 15,000 spend (income AED 15,000-29,999) or AED 1,000 after AED 20,000 (income AED 30,000+); needs 10 digital-wallet purchases within 60 days; apply by 31 Dec 2026

cards.notes: First-year annual fee waived; AED 787.50 from year two but reversed when prior-12-month spend reaches AED 100,000. CBD Rewards point value is not published on the pages read; AED 0.005/pt is a conservative assumption (aggregator implies about 0.0065). 2.5 pts/AED local, 3 abroad, 0.5/0.75 on low-yield categories. Welcome offer spend must be on a digital wallet (Apple/Google/Samsung Pay).

cards.name: Super Saver

fee_waiver.text: First year free; AED 420 from year two

rules.name: Bills (utilities)
rules.conditions: 3% tier; tiers rise with total monthly card spend

insurance.text: Multi-trip travel insurance to USD 500,000 (90 days/trip); purchase protection; extended warranty

welcome_offer.text: AED 300 (income 8,000-9,999, AED 6,000 spend), AED 500 (income 10,000-19,999, AED 10,000 spend) or AED 600 (income 20,000+, AED 12,000 spend); 10 wallet purchases within 60 days; apply by 31 Dec 2026. Bank page advertises up to AED 1,000 combined with Visa Infinite

cards.notes: Cashback rate depends on TOTAL monthly card spend: below AED 3,000 nothing; 3% from 3,000 (AED 75 cap per category, AED 300 total); 5% from 10,000 (AED 100/400); 10% from 20,000 (AED 150/600). Rules model the lowest tier conservatively; full ladder in spend_tiers. Only bills, education, supermarkets and fuel earn; everything else appears to earn nothing. International fee 3.5%. First year fee free, AED 420 after.

cards.name: One

insurance.text: Multi-trip travel insurance to USD 500,000; purchase protection; doubled warranty

welcome_offer.text: 0% interest on 6/12-month balance transfer or cash-on-call if requested within 30 days of issue (1.99%/2.99% processing fee); valid to 31 Dec 2026

cards.notes: Free for life. Cashback is 100% of spend at listed merchants, capped AED 135/month, and only if total monthly spend is AED 5,000+; credited the following month. Everything else earns nothing. 'Signature' tier from aggregator's Visa Signature cover mention.

deals.name: Partner merchants
deals.conditions: cashback equals spend at noon, Amazon, Careem, Uber, Booking.com, Talabat, Deliveroo and cinemas, up to AED 135/month; needs AED 5,000 total card spend that month
deals.note: ticket/partner discount, not a % of spend; excluded from earn engine

cards.name: Yes Rewards

fee_waiver.text: First year free; later years waived with AED 12,000 annual spend

rules.name: ENOC and EPPCO fuel
rules.conditions: 3% (below AED 2,500 monthly spend); rises to 10% (cap AED 125) at AED 2,500+ and 15% (cap AED 175) at AED 10,000+

welcome_offer.text: 20,000 Yes Rewards (AED 200) after any AED 1 spend within 90 days of issue

cards.notes: 100 Yes Rewards = AED 1. Fuel tiers depend on TOTAL monthly spend; rules model the lowest (3%, AED 75 cap). Government, bills, education, groceries, fuel outside ENOC/EPPCO, auto, rent, real estate and fast food earn nothing. First year free, AED 208.95 after, waived with AED 12,000 yearly spend. Cinema/golf/valet perks on old copy no longer apply per aggregator.

cards.name: Smiles Visa Signature

fee_waiver.text: First year free; later years waived with AED 24,000 annual spend (aggregator)

lounge.text: Up to 8 visits per calendar year per cardholder; first free then USD 1 intl spend

insurance.text: Multi-trip travel insurance to USD 500,000; 24/7 concierge; purchase protection

welcome_offer.text: First year annual fee waived; 90-day Smiles Unlimited; AED 200 extra Unravel hotel discount voucher

cards.notes: Official: annual fee AED 500 + VAT = 525, first year free; aggregator says waived from year two with AED 24,000 annual spend. Smiles point value is not stated on pages read: AED 0.01 assumed (unverified). 10 pts/AED on e&/Smiles/elGrocer (25,000 pts/month cap), 2 domestic, up to 3 abroad, 5,000 pts bonus each quarter after AED 10,000 spend the previous quarter.

cards.name: Smiles Visa Platinum

fee_waiver.text: First year free; from year two waived with AED 12,000 annual retail spend (bank page)

rules.name: Low-yield categories
rules.conditions: supermarkets, government, fuel, education, auto, rental, insurance

cinema.text: 50% off two Novo tickets a month

insurance.text: Optional Credit Shield at 1% of monthly outstanding balance; page lists complimentary insurance without detail

welcome_offer.text: First year annual fee waived; AED 200 extra Unravel hotel discount

cards.notes: Bank page only: annual fee AED 199 + VAT assumed 208.95, free in year one; salary requirement not read; Smiles point value (AED 0.01) is an unverified assumption. 'Up to' 1.5 pts domestic, 2 abroad, 5 pts on e&/Smiles/elGrocer (cap 10,000/month); 7,500 bonus pts per quarter at AED 27,500 spend. Bank page re-read: min salary AED 5,000 (confirmed employee), fee AED 199 + 5% VAT from year two, waiver at AED 12,000 yearly spend. The page's own category earn table renders as zeros so base/category rates remain from earlier read; no lounge listed; FX fee not on page.

cards.name: Visa Platinum

dining.text: BOGO dining/lifestyle offers via CBD app and 2-for-1 via Entertainer by Visa

insurance.text: Optional Credit Shield at 1% of monthly outstanding balance

welcome_offer.text: 0% on balance transfer and cash-on-call (6 or 12 months) if requested within 30 days of issuance; processing 1.99% (6m) or 2.99% (12m); valid to 31 Dec 2026

cards.notes: No annual fee ever; up to 1.5 CBD points per AED stated without category breakdown, so rate rules left empty and base 0 (unknown). Min salary AED 5,000 for confirmed employees. Up to 5 free supplementary cards. FX fee not stated. Raised from low to medium: bank page re-read and consistent, but earn detail missing.
